title: Host the cloud PR-review boot on pi-durable, or operator confirms its omp floor
description:
[A1] says every worker, implement and role jobs, local and cloud, runs on pi-durable. The cloud PR-review boot still runs omp on GLM: reviewHarness() drops pi-durable and pi and falls back to omp. Its exception was written onto 43y's notes for worker 8em (2026-10-05 18:25), and no amendment record or operator commit confirms it, because .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/amendments/ does not exist. Either the operator confirms the exception on the record, or the review conversation moves onto a hosted WorkerAgent (a review boot/finish contract in the image, the supervisor routed off the CLI floor).
evidence: cloudflare/src/worker-boot.ts:504 (REVIEW_DEFAULT_HARNESS = "omp"), :529 (NOT_A_REVIEW_HARNESS); .tick/issues/43y.json notes 2026-10-05 18:25

ticfac run epic-43y created this tick by absorbing the finding d89b47c98c8aba305e706bf59f45aaa3b6f3f22d9ac52428aeabf716fc119c93 (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-j2k/attempt-69): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/d89b47c98c8aba305e706bf59f45aaa3b6f3f22d9ac52428aeabf716fc119c93.json on the run branch.
